instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: Before class, I mark parts to discuss with my middle school Japanese class. I look at the lesson plan spread across the teacher's desk. I think about where to add a check. It would make sure everyone has put their phone away. I want them to focus on the text, not their screens. But I want to protect more than test scores or a quiet classroom. I want time to hear how other people see things differently. I read the parts I marked again, then suddenly stop. What if all these checks leave less time to read the text that matters? It is my job to keep the lesson moving. I cannot think a quiet classroom is enough.
